chrome.tagline: Practise the interview before it counts.

landing.hero: Practise the interview before it counts
landing.subhead: An HR and a technical interviewer, a real conversation, and a scored report on every answer.
landing.ctaNote: Free while in preview. No card, no setup.
landing.signIn: Already have an account? Sign in

practice.title: Questions for your role
practice.body: Paste a job listing or name the role — the questions follow it, not a generic list.

feedback.title: Feedback on every answer
feedback.body: Each answer is scored against the criteria the question was asked for.

progress.title: A report you can reread
progress.body: Strengths, gaps and the full transcript, kept after the interview ends.

preview.label: A few minutes in
preview.hrQuestion: Tell me about a project that slipped. What did you do about it?
preview.answer: I cut the scope back to what the release needed and told the client the same day.
preview.techQuestion: This query gets slow at ten million rows. Where do you look first?
preview.score: Scored 4 / 5 — clear structure, name the result

closing.line: Ten minutes now, fewer surprises on the day.

empty.title: No interviews yet
empty.body: Name the role, answer for ten minutes, read the report. That is the whole loop.

auth.registerSubtitle: Practise interviews and get a report on every answer.
auth.verifyPendingSubtitle: We sent a link to your inbox.
auth.verifyPendingWhatNext: Open it to confirm this address. The link works once and expires.
auth.verifyConfirmedBody: Your address is verified. You can start an interview whenever you like.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email address and we will send a reset link.
auth.forgotSentBody: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires in an hour.
auth.resetSubtitle: Setting a new password signs you out on every device.
auth.passwordsMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.resetDoneBody: You have been signed out everywhere. Sign in again with your new password.

onboarding.step1Subtitle: Your name and role help us tailor your interviews.
onboarding.step2Subtitle: Add up to five entries. You can skip this for now.
onboarding.step3Subtitle: A few words help us pick better questions.
onboarding.cvFailed: The CV did not upload. Choose the file again.
onboarding.saveFailed: This step was not saved. Try again.

setup.title: Set up your interview
setup.subtitle: The questions come from the listing you add.
setup.listingHint: Paste the listing you are practising for — every question is written from it.
setup.listingUpload: Or upload the listing as a PDF
setup.listingUploadHint: The PDF is kept with the interview. Paste the text above as well — we cannot read it out of the file yet.
setup.choiceNotSent: These two shape this screen only — the interview takes the occupation from the listing and the language from your account.

preJoin.title: Microphone check
preJoin.subtitle: Grant the microphone and confirm your input. Nothing is recorded on this screen.
preJoin.quiet: We're not picking anything up — say something
preJoin.enterHint: Grant the microphone to enter the room

denied.title: Microphone access is blocked
denied.step1: Open the site settings from your browser's address bar
denied.step2: Allow the microphone for this site
denied.step3: Come back here and try again

unavailable.title: No microphone found
unavailable.body: Connect a microphone and reload this page, or start a text interview instead.

room.submitHint: Write an answer to send it.

voice.lost: The voice connection dropped. Your interview is safe — reconnect to keep going.

report.title: Your report
report.waitHint: This usually takes under a minute. The page updates itself.
report.waitTimedOut: This is taking longer than expected. Refresh in a moment.
report.earlyEnd: This interview ended early — the report scores what was answered.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are missing or invalid. Check them and try again.

errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This action is not available right now. Refreshing…

errors.DAILY_INTERVIEW_LIMIT: You have reached the daily interview limit. Try again tomorrow.
errors.LISTING_REQUIRED: Add a job listing to start an interview.

errors.PDF_TEXT_TOO_SHORT: Could not extract text from this PDF. Paste the listing text instead.
errors.PROVIDER_KEY_MISSING: A required API key is missing. Check your configuration.

errors.AI_OUTPUT_INVALID: The AI response could not be processed. Try again.

errors.VOICE_SESSION_EXPIRED: Voice session has expired. Start it again.
errors.AVATAR_KEY_MISMATCH: Persona avatar key does not match content.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your email address to start an interview.
errors.EMAIL_TOKEN_INVALID: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.EMAIL_TOKEN_EXPIRED: This link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.EMAIL_RESEND_COOLDOWN: Wait a moment before requesting another email.
errors.CV_TRUNCATED: Your CV was too long and was shortened.
errors.PROFILE_DOB_STRIPPED: Date of birth was removed from the extracted profile.

empty.title: No interviews yet
empty.body: Set one up and it will show here with its report.

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Every interview on the platform, deleted ones included.

forbidden.title: Not authorized
forbidden.body: This area is limited to platform administrators.

interviews.heading: All interviews
interviews.caption: Every interview on the platform, newest first, deleted rows included.
